rows.grounds: numeral referring to a set of eight
fused form of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam; equates attainment of powers with the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula in relation to the eight powers and the attainment of siddhis?
premises: The eight are included as a defining element.
The attainment of siddhis is identified with the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed directly to the goddess.
items.inference: The root Kaula is defined as encompassing the eight and the attainment of siddhis.
uncertainties: The specific referent of the eight is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the eight, along with the attainment of siddhis, constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
